# Pulse task #2683: W12: Complete existing native devices and basic EQ, filter and analysis coverage

Operation: 89b2079eeb39698f2df825a843bcaaf7
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

Part of Hex native device roadmap #2661, goal 3, version 0.1. Astra assessment: 17 October 2026.

Goal: turn the existing originals into explicit full functional targets before proliferating shallow copies.

Deliverables:
- Create feature-by-feature audits for Utility, EQ8, Saturator, Compressor, Gate, Auto Pan–Tremolo and Vector against the pinned reference. Preserve their stable identities and old-patch laws; previously completed finite tickets remain done.
- Complete missing controls/modes in focused slices and measure reference laws separately. Known examples: full modern Auto Pan timing/waveform/mode behavior, Compressor/Gate detector/sidechain/lookahead paths, Saturator curves/color/quality; consume W09/W13/W14 as needed rather than hide missing modes.
- Integrate #2654's dynamic EQ/automation and #2657 state descriptors, preserving bank/band IDs and graph gesture semantics. Audit EQ quality/response/oversampling with current owner evidence.
- Add Channel EQ, EQ Three and Auto Filter using shared filters, follower/LFO, response widgets and sidechains; modern Auto Filter mode revision is explicitly pinned.
- Expose Spectrum as a complete registered observational device by reusing the existing calibrated spectrum worker; UI analysis remains decoupled from audible DSP. Tuner's analysis kernel is delivered in W17.
- Audit Vector's already-implemented v15 globals/harmonics/envelopes/filter/LFO/controller/quality catalog and remaining features; do not reopen those as absent.

Acceptance: each device has a complete control inventory with actual canonical/DSP bindings; no decorative controls; all state/preset/history/transport and common conformance checks pass. Each reference comparison has explicit tolerance/confidence; original-law differences remain visible. Native visual/listening evidence is recorded per finite scope.

Sources: each current device module and owning docs, docs/vector-global.md; official audio/instrument references. Dependencies on later families apply only to relevant missing modes, allowing independent completion slices.

Planning workstream: split implementation into focused PRs as work begins. Related canonical tickets: #18, #19, #2249, #2654, #2657, #31. Preserve their current scope, versions, status and PR history. Dependency edges order the enabling contracts; downstream production proof is qualified incrementally under W20.
